en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a picturesque village with large wooden buildings set at the edge of a forest. The style of the buildings is typical of Central European mountain or spa towns. There is forested terrain in the background and an open grassy area in the foreground. The text 'Oberbärenburg i. sächs. Erzgeb.' is printed on the upper part of the image.
